incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert INC-2026 fired for service=redwood-inference-canary (us-west-2). symptom=canary 5xx surge (>10% of requests) for last 3m. alert: https://pd.example/INC-2026
pd-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026 triggered -> primary on-call: @sre-rotation, escalation policy: infra-oncall. auto-escalation in 6m if unacked.
sre-rotation: ack. I'm taking this. starting quick triage now. can anyone confirm if deploy happened in the last 30m?
mike.ops: I see a canary rollout finished ~18m ago: image redwood/inference:1.7.2 -> 1.8.0. Telemetry shows a p99 hop up and 503s from the canary pool.
sre-rotation: copying logs. to be explicit: are errors internal 5xx from runtime or upstream?
ana-ml: preliminary traces show kernel path for quantized attention touching a new fused op in 1.8.0. stack shows segfault -> 502/503. might be regression from kernel selection.
jamie-se: pulling customer impact from support — @carol-support any hits?
carol-support: we have 7 active customer incidents in the last 10m reporting "model returns 503" for embedding endpoints. customers: acme-corp(enterprise), sleepwell-inc. I've DM'd account reps.
sre-rotation: ok. priority = P1. mitigation plan: (1) reduce canary traffic to 0, (2) scale stable up to absorb traffic, (3) rollback canary to 1.7.2 if needed. executing step 1 now.
(oncall-bot): Running traffic-split command.
```
# reduce canary weight via routing API
redwood route update inference-model --canary-weight 0
```
sre-rotation: canary weight set to 0 (confirmed). routing metrics show traffic diverted to stable within 30s.
mike.ops: scaling stable to handle extra load (kubectl scale deployment inference-stable --replicas=12).
```
# quick healthcheck against stable
curl -sS https://stable.us-west-2.api.redwood/infer/health | jq .status
```
ana-ml: running quick regression check against local reproducer: triggering quant attention path gives immediate crash on 1.8.0, no crash on 1.7.2.
ops-manager: given customer impact and reproducible crash, recommend immediate rollback of canary to 1.7.2 and hold rollout.
sre-rotation: agreed. initiating rollback.
```
# rollback image for canary
kubectl set image deployment/inference-canary inference=redwood/inference:1.7.2 -n prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-canary -n prod
```
pd-bot: INC-2026 acknowledged by @sre-rotation. escalation timer paused.
sre-rotation: rollback started; watching rollout status.
(90s later)
sre-rotation: rollback complete, canary pods on 1.7.2 and passing liveness. 5xx rate dropped to baseline (~0.3%).
incident-bot: automatic alert suppression: duplicate INCs for the same rule suppressed for 10m.
carol-support: notified affected customers that we routed them to stable and rolled back the canary; accounts acknowledged.
jamie-se: can we get a short post-incident note for account teams? I'll draft a one-pager.
ana-ml: root cause looks like a kernel selection bug for quantized attention in 1.8.0 optimizer path. I'll open an issue and add a minimal reproducer.
ops-manager: action items: (a) block 1.8.0 rollout until kernel fix, (b) add smoke test for quant path on canary gate, (c) tighten canary 5xx alert thresholds and add an additional canary-level perf monitor.
sre-rotation: filing incident ticket and tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for follow-up. temporary mitigations in place.
ops-manager: good work. PD escalation cleared. can someone please add timeline + logs to INC-2026?
sre-rotation: adding timeline and key logs now.
(reacts: :white_check_mark: by ops-manager, :thumbsup: by jamie-se)
oncall-bot: scheduled follow-up meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC for RCA; invite eng-runtime, eng-ml, SRE.
carol-support: I'll send customer follow-up notes after the RCA.
jamie-se: quick note: please make sure the rollback window and traffic-diversion steps are documented in runbook under "canary regression".
sre-rotation: will update runbook with explicit `redwood route update` and `kubectl set image` snippets.
pd-bot: INC-2026 status -> acknowledged -> resolved (auto-resolve triggered after 30m of stable metrics).
incident-bot: final status: mitigation successful, no further pages for the rule. follow-ups: ENG-2451 (kernel bug), RUNBOOK-67 (canary smoke), MON-101 (tighten canary 5xx alert).
